caption: The drawing depicts a detailed representation of an eagle with its wings fully spread upwards. The eagle’s body is positioned in profile, but both wings are visible and filled with intricate feather details. The eagle’s beak is open, and its talons are gripping a small sphere that is attached to a vertical pole extending downward. The whole composition is rendered in black and shades of gray on a light tan or beige background. The eagle occupies the central portion of the drawing, and the background is left plain except for some small, scattered brownish spots. In the lower right corner, the name "Rollington Campbell" is printed.
title: Weather Vane Finial
